findings.description: Footer copyright line is in English on the French site.
Subtitle uses informal "tu" while the rest of the site (e.g. title "qui vous ressemble") uses "vous".
"Appliquer pour" is a well-known anglicism (calque of "apply for"); Quebec usage is "faire une demande de".

findings.expected: Use a French banner (e.g. banner-fr.png) reading "Un financement adapté à vos projets — Taux concurrentiels. Modalités claires. Aucune surprise."
findings.description: The French landing page displays the English banner image with English text "Financing that fits your plans / Competitive rates. Clear terms. No surprises."
Required-field error for "Nom complet" is shown in English on the French form, while other fields' errors are translated.

findings.expected: Remove fixed width / overflow hidden on .btn-compact, or shorten to "Soumettre la demande".
findings.description: Submit button text is clipped to "Soumettre ma demande" (scrollWidth 290 > clientWidth 210, overflow hidden, nowrap).
"e-mail" is not standard Canadian French usage; the OQLF term is "courriel".

findings.observed: Merci. Votre demande pour {montant} a été reçue.
findings.expected: Merci. Votre demande de 25 000,00 $ a été reçue.
findings.description: The confirmation message shows the raw template token {montant} instead of the loan amount (the French key name likely doesn't match the variable passed).
"Pay later" is translated as "Payer maintenant" (pay now), the opposite meaning, contradicting the help text about a deferred first payment.
Estimated monthly payment uses English currency format on the French page.

findings.observed: Aucune accusation pour un remboursement anticipé.
findings.expected: Aucuns frais pour un remboursement anticipé.
findings.description: "Charges" was translated in its legal sense ("accusation" = criminal charge) instead of fees ("frais").

findings.expected: Taux variable de 5,2 %, sous réserve de l'approbation du crédit.
findings.description: The French rate note drops the "subject to credit approval" condition.

findings.expected: Use the French version of promo-a showing "Taux variable : 5,2 %".
findings.description: The French page shows a different promo image advertising a fixed 4.9% rate, contradicting its alt text and the English page (variable 5.2%).
"Close" (the verb, to close the dialog) was translated as the adjective "Proche" (near).
"Balance" is an anglicism for an account balance; the correct banking term in French is "solde".
In French, zero takes the singular; the English plural rule was applied.
Section heading left in English on the French dashboard.
Transaction dates on the French dashboard use US MM/DD/YYYY order, which is ambiguous and not Canadian French convention (applies to all rows).
A bank "statement" is a "relevé" in French; "déclaration" means a declaration/filing.
The French dashboard link points to the English calculator, switching the user to English.
The French application confirmation page declares its document language as English.

findings.observed: Not Found — The requested URL was not found on the server. If you entered the URL manually please check your spelling and try again.
findings.expected: Page introuvable — La page demandée est introuvable. Si vous avez saisi l'adresse manuellement, vérifiez l'orthographe et réessayez.
findings.description: The 404 page under /fr/ is the default English server error page, with no localization.
